messages:
noah: quick pass on the Compliance modal — retention / region / encryption section. figma: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz (see the right panel). Can people drop tiny nits? :eyes:
jamal: first impression — region dropdown order feels random. can we: 1) show user-default region at top, 2) then preferred/paired regions, 3) then alphabetical rest? saves clicks when provisioning.
elaine: copy nit: 'Data retention: 90 days' reads like a label. Suggest: 'Retention period — 90 days (max 365). Read more' with a link to policy. less ambiguous.
taylor: KMS badge is confusing in the small card. current text 'KMS' alone isn't accessible. propose 'Customer-managed key (KMS)' on hover and visible alt text for screen readers. also the badge contrast falls below 4.5:1 on dark modes. :a11y:
noah: +1 on both. also found tooltip overlap — when you open audit log details the KMS tooltip covers the region selector on narrow screens. needs z-index + responsive placement.
jamal: UX flow: when customer toggles 'Use customer key', we should open a short inline stepper instead of modal. less context-switch for users who are configuring retention at same time.
elaine: audit log copy: current 'Download logs' -> change to 'Export audit trail (CSV) — includes admin events; remove sensitive user content by default.' add a short warning: 'Export may contain user identifiers; contact security for subpoenas.'
taylor: keyboard: tab order hits help link then skips the 'region' select because of the hidden tooltip button. ensure tooltips are focusable but don't steal focus. also add aria-describedby on the KMS badge: aria-describedby="kms-desc" and make the desc text sr-only: 'Key stored in customer KMS — Redwood never has access.'
noah: tiny microcopy: 'Retention applies to generated outputs, not raw prompts' — customers keep asking this. we should add inline helper text under the retention slider.
jamal: mobile: region selector should collapse to a single-line summary (e.g., 'Region: us-west1') and expand to full list only after tapping — avoids huge dropdown on small screens.	design-bot: accessibility-check: color-contrast (KMS badge) FAILED, focus-order (tooltip) WARN, label-clarity PASS. See /a11y-report-1749623482.
elaine: I'll draft the copy changes and push a small PR for the modal and audit export wording. tagging @noah for signoff before we publish.
noah: thanks — ping me once PR is up. I'll also add a note in the release notes about the retention clarified language. :thumbsup:
